name: tech-tree-designer.setpoint-read
purpose: Enumerate all ecosystem-design outcomes and compose bounded proto-plan, ontology and skill-registry diagnostics without manufacturing product acceptance.

collect_diagnostics.description: False reads only the declared outcome inventory; it never qualifies live behavior.

assumptions: The PRD owns outcome meaning; the caller's approved mandate owns required selection. ecosystem-design-v1 contains all 18 PRD outcomes, not an approval of optional tiers.
No owner acceptance sensor is implemented for the expanded product. All outcome rows remain pending_telemetry and all acceptance bands remain null; numeric proposals have not been approved.
Live diagnostics require Tech Tree Designer, SDA, Prompt Manager and Program Runtime. The nested skill-set program has its own bounded read-only contract; an incomplete child remains unknown.
Ontology counts are authored inventory, not verified capability fulfillment. Existing proto-plan inventory is not repository-wide proposal evidence.
invariants: Read-only: no inference, delegation, publication, owner restart, private HTTP or filesystem access.
All 18 outcomes survive missing or failed diagnostic reads; required unknown outcomes cannot be accepted.
Diagnostic values are never banded. Missing targets remain distinct from missing measurements.

One bounded JSON envelope on catchable program paths. Runtime cancellation or hard budget termination can prevent reporting; the caller must retain that failure as unknown, never acceptance. At most three diagnostics and one child summary; no artifact content or source errors are returned.
No materialize call. The nested child has its own head limit of 50; this parent reads at most one child envelope.

signals.target_revision: ecosystem-design-v1; inventory identity, not a reviewed mandate digest
signals.acceptance: Always unknown until owner-backed acceptance is implemented
signals.rows: 18 standard setpoint rows keyed by PRD OT-P0-001..009, OT-P1-001..006, OT-P2-001..003. reading, target and in_band are null; unavailable true; reason pending_telemetry.
signals.required_selection: caller_mandate; no implicit approval or filtering of unknown outcomes
signals.diagnostics: At most three unbanded standard rows: proto-plans count, ontology capability/scenario counts, skill-registry usage/improve booleans. Failed reads have null reading and a validity reason.
signals.child: Optional bounded skill-set child status and artifact digest, acceptance_eligible false. Child success alone does not prove complete readings.

outputs.evidence: At most three governed read or child program locators; not acceptance receipts

fixtures.note: Executed permanent-gap path; no live owner observation.
Typed admission rejection, not executed product behavior.
Healthy child and owners should yield ok; a partial result fails this qualification rather than normalizing an outage.
